name: Dormacet
description: A fast-acting GABAergic compound engineered for BCI-integrated nervous systems, Dormacet suppresses cortical ping-response and induces full unconsciousness within 28-35 seconds of sublingual absorption. Designed for shift workers and data-labor professionals whose BCIs create chronic sleep-onset insomnia, it became the most prescribed sleep aid in GLMZ within a decade of release.
effects: Suppresses BCI interrupt signals during sleep cycle
Clean wake profile with minimal grogginess
Normalizes sleep architecture for first 6 hours
side_effects: Paradoxical BCI loop-dreams in 8% of users
Mild retrograde amnesia for events immediately preceding dose
Dependency on external sleep onset develops over time
Dangerous interaction with older chrome neural bridges — can suppress autonomic regulation
cultural_context: Called 'the working person's mercy' in Tier 2 circles. Data couriers, factory-floor techs, and logistics workers who run always-on BCIs take Dormacet nightly as a matter of survival. Novafold markets it with the slogan 'Your mind deserves an off switch.' There's a quiet shame culture around it — people who can't sleep without it rarely admit it.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 courier discovers their Dormacet supply has been laced with a passive memory-extraction compound — someone is harvesting dream-adjacent data from thousands of users nightly.

Novafold's prescription database for Dormacet gets leaked, revealing that three Tier 4 corporate executives have been filling prescriptions under false Tier 2 identities — why are they hiding that they use it?
A street chemist on the Shelf has synthesized an unlicensed Dormacet analog that works in 8 seconds — too fast. People are collapsing mid-sentence, and three have died when they fell.
